purpose: Test whether pre-specified reporter dependence on selected bilateral trade partners, combined with a partner-specific export-flow contraction, provides a reproducible predictive signal for subsequent material GDP deterioration.

scientific_scope.question: Does dependence on a specifically selected partner add information beyond total exports and beyond an arbitrary assignment of dominant-partner identity?
not_claimed: No causal effect of a partner is inferred.
No geopolitical responsibility, policy responsibility, or production shock is inferred from a bilateral flow contraction.
No partner is called a cause because it is selected as dominant.
No result is eligible for runtime or positive Path Composer weight unless it passes the supervisor gate.

source_contract.economic_target_source: World Bank WDI series already present in CHAOS macro panel
source_contract.source_separation: IMTS and WDI remain separate source observations; only exact reporter/year keys are joined; no source averaging or reconciliation.
source_contract.vintage_policy: Record the IMTS dataset version, publication/update metadata, acquisition timestamp, raw request URL, response headers, and SHA-256. Historical observed values only; no projections or future revisions may be introduced after the contract is frozen.

analysis_unit.source_native_unit: reporter x counterpart_country x indicator x annual observation
analysis_unit.target_deduplication_rule: At most one GDP outcome record per reporter-year-horizon. Multiple shocked partners are aggregated into one reporter-year exposure record with shocked partner IDs retained.
analysis_unit.partner_level_analysis: Diagnostic and audit layer only; partner-level rows must not be treated as independent GDP outcomes.

native_frequency_and_period.reason_for_late_origin_exclusion: The material GDP outcome at t+3 is not observed inside the frozen 2000-2024 panel.

dimension_requirements.indicator_definition: Exports of goods, Free on board (FOB), US dollar
dimension_requirements.scale_rule: Preserve SCALE as metadata; use OBS_VALUE exactly as delivered; do not multiply, divide, or reinterpret the raw value by SCALE.

partner_selection.selection_rule: For each reporter, rank eligible counterpart codes by the arithmetic mean of raw XG_FOB_USD values divided by raw G001 World XG_FOB_USD values for each complete year in 2000-2004, requiring all five bilateral and World observations to be present. Select the top 5 eligible counterpart codes.
partner_selection.selection_tie_break: Descending baseline_share, then ascending source counterpart code.

dominance_rule.definition: A selected partner is dominant if its 2000-2004 baseline mean share is at least 0.20.

partner_selection.selection_failure: If a reporter has fewer than 5 eligible counterpart codes with complete 2000-2004 bilateral and World observations, that reporter is excluded from the primary test and recorded as not_testable_selection_coverage; no fallback partner selection is allowed.

partner_exclusion_policy.purpose: Prevent aggregate, unknown, non-specific, or non-comparable counterpart codes from being treated as named bilateral partners.
partner_exclusion_policy.world_denominator_exception: G001=World is excluded as a named partner but required only as the same-source denominator for reporter total exports.
partner_exclusion_policy.manual_exclusion_rule: No manual exclusion may be added after seeing GDP results. Any code not classifiable from the official codelist is quarantined and recorded, not silently included.
partner_exclusion_policy.exclusion_not_equal_to_missing: Excluded counterpart codes are not converted to zero and do not fill missing bilateral observations.

primary_state.definition: At reporter r and origin year t, at least one selected baseline-dominant partner p has raw XG_FOB_USD(r,p,t) < 0.70 * raw XG_FOB_USD(r,p,t-1), with exact consecutive source years and both values positive and present.
primary_state.threshold_meaning: A raw bilateral export value contraction of more than 30 percent relative to the immediately preceding annual source observation; the raw values remain unchanged.
primary_state.exposure_formula: exposure(r,t)=1 if any selected baseline-dominant p has shock(r,p,t)=1
primary_state.dependence_formula: dependence(r)=1 if at least one selected p has baseline_share(r,p)>=0.20
primary_state.missing_policy: If either bilateral value is missing, non-positive, non-annual, duplicated, or not an exact t/t-1 pair, shock is missing for that partner-year; it is not False and not zero.
primary_state.state_semantics: Candidate trade-flow state only; not a production shock, supply shock, causal shock, or geopolitical attribution.

target_definition.target_definition: GDP annual percentage growth; constant 2015 US$ basis, as stored in the frozen CHAOS macro panel.
target_definition.future_data_usage: Future GDP enters only as the transition outcome label after the current-state exposure is frozen; no future GDP is used in partner selection or exposure construction.
target_definition.missing_policy: Complete-case per reporter and horizon; missing target values remain missing and remove that reporter-origin-horizon from that metric only.

chronological_design.origin_horizon_rule: For each h, use only origins with an observed target at t+h; do not backfill or truncate the outcome into a proxy.

primary_statistics.formula: P(material_deterioration at t+h | interaction_state=1) - P(material_deterioration at t+h | interaction_state=0)
secondary_descriptives: share of reporters with positive risk difference

partner_identity_null.purpose: Test whether the identity assignment of dominant partners carries information beyond the number of dominant slots, the reporter, the bilateral flow series, and the observed shock timing.

procedure: For each reporter, retain the selected five bilateral partner time series, all raw values, all missingness, and all observed partner-specific shock flags.
Retain the reporter-specific number of baseline-dominant slots m, where m is the count of selected partners meeting the 0.20 baseline-share rule.
For each permutation, randomly reassign the m dominant labels among the five selected partner series within that reporter.
Apply one fixed permutation per reporter across all years, not a separate permutation per year, preserving temporal dependence within every bilateral flow series.
Recompute the reporter-year interaction exposure from the permuted dominant labels and the unchanged partner-specific shocks.
Keep the WDI GDP outcome labels unchanged.
Compute the max risk difference across h=1,2,3 for the permuted exposure.
preserves: number of dominant slots per reporter
primary_identity_null.breaks_only: The mapping between dominant-partner identity and the bilateral flow series.
primary_identity_null.interpretation: A small p-value means the observed dominant-partner assignment is unusual under random identity assignment with the same reporter-level structure; it does not establish causality.

secondary_identity_control.procedure: Within reporter, permute dominant labels among selected partners separately within baseline-share rank strata when at least two partners exist in a stratum; if a stratum cannot be formed, mark the replicate not_testable rather than forcing a match.
secondary_identity_control.purpose: Sensitivity to the fact that dominant slots may be concentrated in a few very large bilateral series.

identity_null_failure_rules: Do not permute partner labels independently by year.
Do not resample outcomes independently of reporter.
Do not select a new partner set inside a null replicate.
Do not replace missing bilateral observations with zero.
Do not allow a null replicate to change the selection window, threshold, or reporter set.
Do not pool partner-level rows as independent outcomes.

outcome_null.procedure: Within each reporter, permute the complete-case GDP outcome labels across eligible origin years separately for each horizon while keeping the frozen interaction exposure unchanged.
outcome_null.purpose: Test whether the observed exposure-outcome ordering exceeds a reporter-preserving label null.

cluster_bootstrap.purpose: Describe uncertainty under cross-sectional dependence; not a substitute for confirmation or identity null.

multiple_testing_and_promotion.test_family: one primary interaction exposure across three horizons and two required null controls
promotion_requires_all: confirmation direction not contradicted materially by validation
no dependence on a single reporter or a single partner code
no schema, provenance, frequency, or missingness violations

entity_concentration.rule: If either concentration limit is exceeded, the edge cannot be promoted; report it as concentrated or rejected depending on coverage.

reproducibility.rerun_policy: A rerun with changed partner exclusion, selection window, thresholds, reporter scope, null procedure, or outcome definition is a new versioned contract, not a silent update of V1.

decision_states.candidate: Contract or descriptive hypothesis exists but has not passed the required tests.
decision_states.supported_predictive: All predeclared confirmation, null, coverage, and stability gates pass; still not causal.
decision_states.rejected: The tested interaction fails a required predictive or identity-control condition.
decision_states.unresolved: Evidence is contradictory or concentrated and cannot be adjudicated by this contract.
decision_states.not_testable: Coverage, complete-case, source, or frequency requirements are insufficient.
